answer: Every claim climbs the beacon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ivory re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Reaching the kernel of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
